# Why doesn't "every cell does everything" keep working?

<!-- STEP id="imagine-building-a" -->
Imagine building a bicycle using only identical screwdrivers.

<!-- STEP id="adding-more-screwdrivers" -->
Adding more screwdrivers gives more of the same tool, but not tools for tasks requiring different equipment.

<!-- STEP id="the-problem-is" -->
The problem is not number. Different tasks require different kinds of work.

<!-- STEP id="the-analogy-stops" -->
The analogy stops there. Cells are living systems, not tools.
